newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Westfield to run St Lukes centres.
newsitem.headline: Westfield to run St Lukes centres.

text.p: St Lukes Group said on Thursday that Westfield Holdings had been appointed to manage and develop its NZ$700 million New Zealand shopping centre portfolio.
The management contract will commence on May 1.

In addition to the appointment of Westfield ST Lukes announced the appointment of Andrew Bennett as its new chief executive officer following the retirement of the former CEO Paul Preston due to illness.

"The Board's decision was based on the expectation that Westfield will accelerate St Lukes' earnings growth over the next few years, particularly through the development of existing and new centres, to an extent which could not be achieved by augmenting current management resources," St Lukes said in a statement.
"This will ultimately increase the investment value of our portfolio".
The contract, which has been under discussion since last month, follows the resignation of St Lukes managing director Pail Preston for health reasons.

St Lukes management and board is to retain absolute responsibility for the creation of value for shareholders, the New Zealand companye stressed, while Westfield would be accountable to St Lukes management in the same way that its own previous divisional management team had been.
